rubric.role_summary: Hands-on electrical field leader for rapid-deployment utility-scale solar and battery infrastructure in Texas, responsible for permits, crew oversight, grid interconnections, commissioning, and electrical safety.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Hands-on electrical field leader for rapid-deployment utility-scale solar and battery infrastructure in Texas, responsible for permits, crew oversight, grid interconnections, commissioning, and electrical safety.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 7+ years of professional hands-on experience in industrial, commercial, or utility-scale electrical construction.
- Experience leading electrical crews.
- Knowledge of the NEC.
- Ability to read, interpret, and redline complex electrical schematics, three-line diagrams, and instrumentation drawings.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Hands-on installation experience with utility-scale solar fields, commercial solar microgrids, or utility-scale BESS.
- Familiarity with high-voltage DC system hazards, lithium-ion battery management systems, and central inverter technologies.
- Experience in fast-paced, high-stakes operational environments.
- Active OSHA 30 and heavy equipment operation certifications.
- Experience leading electrical crews, managing field subcontractors, and collaborating directly with building inspectors and utility engineers.
- Expert-level knowledge of the NEC, NFPA 70E, and local Texas utility interconnection frameworks.
- Ability to author technical instructions, safety protocols, and field reports.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater El Paso, TX area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
